summary: Discover the NIS 2 Directive Lead Implementer role, essential for enhancing cybersecurity measures and compliance in your organization. Learn more today.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for cybersecurity professionals, IT managers, compliance officers, and government officials who need to implement, audit, or oversee NIS 2 Directive compliance programs in critical infrastructure sectors.
modules: NIS 2 Directive Foundations and Implementation Planning
Cybersecurity Governance and Risk Management Systems
Security Controls and Incident Management Frameworks
Monitoring, Testing, and Continuous Improvement Programs
prerequisites: The main requirements for participating in this training course are having a fundamental understanding of cybersecurity concepts and practices.
